opening.argument: The video presents Mirror Trading International as a route to grow Bitcoin through recurring returns of 10% or more each month. It describes the viewer’s Bitcoin being held and traded by brokers, then reinforces the pitch with a projected 2.59 Bitcoin after ten years of compounding. This is paired with a referral-linked registration page and an instruction to contact the sender, giving viewers concrete steps to pursue the investment offer.

citations.quote: What if you could receive 10% profit, or more, every month.
If you could get just 10% profit per annum, and compound for 10 years, you would have 2.59 bitcoin in that 10 year period
Your Bitcoin remains with the brokers and your bitcoin is traded using advanced trading software.
For more information please contact the person who sent you this video.
